notes.2: Globular proteins are normally soluble and are found in an aqueous environment. Some candidates thought the correct answer was A. This is incorrect since globular proteins need not have a quaternary structure.

notes.general_comments: General comments The mean score was 23.27 (58.18%) and there was a very good spread of scores, the standard deviation being 7.45. Eight questions were answered correctly by 75% or more of candidates – Questions 1, 5, 7, 16, 17, 19, 21 and 25. Six questions were difficult; 40% or fewer candidates answered Questions 2, 3, 26, 27, 28 and 33 correctly. Comments on specific questions The majority of candidates answered this correctly.
